attacksPerMember.description: Present on classic wars (typically 2); omitted on CWL wars (1 attack per member).

warStartTime.description: Present on CWL war responses; omitted on classic wars.

armyShareCode.description: Shareable army composition code, or null when unavailable on a battle log entry.

requiredTownhallLevel.description: Minimum Town Hall level required to join. Note lowercase "h" in wire field name.

location.description: Omitted on worldwide leaderboards for clans without a configured location.

capitalHallLevel.description: Omitted for clans that have not unlocked Clan Capital.

districts.description: Omitted for clans that have not unlocked Clan Capital.

members.description: Participating clan members who have made at least one attack. Present on ongoing raid seasons and omitted on ended seasons.

attacks.description: Individual attacks against this district. Included only for attacked districts in an ongoing raid season; omitted on ended seasons.

location.description: Omitted on worldwide leaderboards for clans without a configured location.

previousRank.description: Previous leaderboard rank, or -1 when unavailable.

previousClanRank.description: Previous clan rank, or 0 for newly joined members.

role.description: Clan role. Note: "admin" represents Elder in-game, and "coLeader" is Co-Leader.

location.description: Omitted on worldwide leaderboards for clans without a configured location.

requiredTownhallLevel.description: Minimum Town Hall level required to join. Note lowercase "h" in wire field name.

warTags.description: War tags for this round. Unmatched future rounds use placeholder "#0".

result.description: War outcome. Often null on CWL season summary rows, though some CWL rows carry win/tie; check for missing opponent.tag to reliably detect CWL rows.

attacks.description: Omitted until the member performs at least one attack.

townhallLevel.description: Member Town Hall level. Note lowercase "h" on the wire (unlike townHallLevel elsewhere).

reason.description: Machine-readable error reason (e.g. badRequest, notFound, accessDenied, accessDenied.invalidIp, tooManyRequests, inMaintenance, unknownException).

Language.description: Omitted when the clan has not configured a chat language.
Language.title: Language

League.description: Legacy pre-2025 league object (often Unranked id 29000000). Prefer leagueTier for current ranked leagues.
League.title: League

creationTime.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp (unlike most other Clash API timestamps, which use compact YYYYMMDDTHHmmss.SSSZ).

clanName.description: Member clan name, or null when the player is clanless.

clanTag.description: Member clan tag, or null when the player is clanless.

medium.description: 288x288 legacy league icon PNG URL. Omitted for Unranked (id 29000000).

id.description: Season identifier: YYYY-MM (2015-07 to 2025-08), YYYY-MM-DD (2025-10-06 to 2026-04-20), or v2-YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ (2026-05-11 onward).

leagueSeasonId.description: Unix epoch timestamp (seconds) identifying the ranked season.

LeagueTier.description: Minimum ranked league tier required to join. Omitted when unset.
LeagueTier.title: LeagueTier

rank.description: Season rank. Omitted on currentSeason when unranked.

Location.description: Omitted when the clan has not configured a location.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Present if and only if isCountry is true.

Location.title: Location

opponent.description: Zeroed placeholder opponent object returned when not in war.

NotInWarClan.description: Zeroed placeholder clan object returned when not in war.
NotInWarClan.title: NotInWarClan

builderBaseLeague.description: Omitted when the player has not unlocked Builder Base.

builderHallLevel.description: Omitted when the player has not unlocked Builder Base.

currentLeagueGroupTag.description: Current ranked league group tag. May be placeholder "#0" (querying /leaguegroup/%230/... returns 404). Omitted when currentLeagueSeasonId is 0.

currentLeagueSeasonId.description: Current ranked league season epoch (seconds), or 0 when the player is not in a league group.

league.description: Legacy pre-2025 league object. Usually omitted; prefer leagueTier.

previousLeagueGroupTag.description: Previous ranked league group tag. May be placeholder "#0" (querying /leaguegroup/%230/... returns 404).

previousLeagueSeasonId.description: Previous ranked league season epoch (seconds), or 0 when unavailable.

role.description: Clan role. Note: "admin" represents Elder in-game, and "coLeader" is Co-Leader.

townHallWeaponLevel.description: Town Hall weapon level. Present for TH12-TH17; omitted for TH1-TH11 and TH18+.

warPreference.description: Omitted when the player is not in a clan.

completionInfo.description: Progress/completion text, or null for achievements that do not report completion info.

PlayerClan.description: Omitted when the player is not in a clan.
PlayerClan.title: PlayerClan

equipment.description: Equipped hero equipment. Present only on Home Village heroes.

type.description: Wire element slot type ("walls" and "decoration", not the official Swagger names FOOT/DECO).

league.description: Legacy pre-2025 league object (often Unranked id 29000000). Prefer leagueTier.

superTroopIsActive.description: Emitted only when true on currently active super troops.

name.description: Internal resource identifier (e.g. Gold, Elixir, DarkElixir, Gold2, CommonOre, CraftingResource1). Not a fixed enum.

token.description: In-game API token to verify. Send literal "TOKEN" against the mock API for a valid response.

destructionPercentage.description: Average destruction percentage (0-100) for classic wars, or the cumulative sum across all CWL rounds (can exceed 100) on CWL summary entries.

name.description: Omitted on CWL season summary entries in the war log.

tag.description: Omitted on CWL season summary entries in the war log. Detecting missing opponent.tag reliably identifies CWL summary rows.

info.description:
Community-maintained Clash of Clans API wire specification and mock server (not affiliated with Supercell).

### Using the mock server (`mock.clashk.ing`)
- **Deterministic variants:** Use `#2PP` for the primary fixture, `#2PPP` for the second variant, and add trailing `P`s for additional variants (see individual endpoint descriptions). Unsupported tags return `400`.
- **Simulate HTTP failures:** Pass header `x-clash-mock-response` with `maintenance`, `unavailable`, `rateLimited`, `notFound`, `forbidden`, `privateWarLog`, `invalidIp`, `invalidRequest`, `internalError`, or `notImplemented` to force that failure response on any route.
